detail.longDescription: The concept of "less is more" doesn't seem to have made it to Silicon Valley. Every time I blink, it seems like there's yet another AI agent available on the market. And right on cue, another AI bombshell has entered the villa: Muse is a personal AI agent from Meta (of Facebook fame) that can do things on your behalf, like opening a browser, filling out forms, and sending emails.
